National bird: Indian peacock, Pavo cristatus (claim c25); protection under the Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972 also taught (c26).
Jana-gana-mana: composed originally in Bengali by Rabindranath Tagore, adopted in its Hindi version by the Constituent Assembly on 24 January 1950 (claim c13).

National River: Ganga — taught from the National Mission for Clean Ganga's own page title/heading 'Ganga-A National River' (claim c30). Sourcing is thinner than for the other symbols (no narrative paragraph on the fetched page), disclosed in REPORT.md.
